body.x: Deep-fusion AI Co., Ltd. (CEO Sunghun Yu) participated in ‘Pre-CES2025 Incheon (IFEZ)’ held on November 13 at the Grand Ballroom C of Songdo Convensia.

The company specializes in applications such as 360-degree deep learning and HD mapping for autonomous driving powered by 4D imaging radar technology. These solutions are integrated into its proprietary controllers and offered as products, aiming to promote the widespread adoption of autonomous navigation across vehicles, ships, and logistics robots. Deep-fusion AI emphasizes its innovative approach to 4D imaging radar deep learning, which international automakers have already tested on cars.

At CES 2025 in Las Vegas, Deep-fusion AI plans to showcase its 4D imaging radar deep learning and HD map solutions. The company aims to present its technology to radar manufacturers and automakers, initiate practical collaboration projects, and gather market insights to refine its solutions. Additionally, it will demonstrate real-time 4D imaging radar-based robotic recognition and spatial mapping as an alternative to expensive LiDAR systems.

body.cap: Deep-fusion AI CEO Sunghun Yu is presenting at the Pre-CES2025 Incheon (IFEZ). | Photo by AVING News

body.x: Deep-fusion AI’s 360-degree deep learning with 4D imaging radar is built on cutting-edge innovations. The company stated, “Unlike optical sensors like cameras or LiDAR, standardized 4D imaging radar deep learning datasets do not yet exist. To address this, we simulate radar specifications in virtual environments to develop pre-training models, enabling manufacturers to achieve performance goals and deploy deep learning applications with product launches. Additionally, we help automakers choose suitable radar placement, pricing, and vehicle specifications.”

Next year, the company plans to launch controllers for autonomous driving and automated valet parking with integrated recognition capabilities, controllers for autonomous ships and docking systems with recognition features, and multi-sensor modules combining multiple 4D imaging radars and cameras for ship navigation.

body.x: Organized by the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZA) and Incheon Technopark, ‘Pre-CES2025 IFEZ’ is part of the ‘Global Top 10 City Incheon Week’ held in the third week of November. Integrating five related events, the event focuses on key themes like healthcare, bio, and smart cities. On November 13, the IFEZ Smart City Tech Conference and the CES2025 Incheon Pavilion showcase occurred concurrently.
